about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/fix (ergo fix, EXPLICIT EX1): edits that TestFixProperty or TestExplicitClauseText must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants internal/sketch/fix.

mutants.name: ex1-needs-for-fails
mutants.rule: A failure is written in the fails clause, a capability in needs.

mutants.name: ex1-no-recheck
mutants.rule: Writing a callee's clause can make its callers exceed theirs: the tool checks again until no clause diagnostic is left.

mutants.name: ex1-after-takes
mutants.rule: A new clause goes after the results and fails, before takes (grammar.md Declarations).

mutants.name: ex1-no-import
mutants.rule: An element of a package the file does not import is written with the import it needs.

mutants.name: ex1-reorder-written
mutants.rule: Written elements keep their written order; the missing ones follow them.

mutants.name: ex1-site-row-text
mutants.rule: Every site of one clause prints the whole clause, one text.

mutants.name: ex2-no-open
mutants.rule: A clause written after a lone result of function type is the function's only when the result is in parentheses; otherwise it is the result type's row.

mutants.name: ex2-no-open-apply
mutants.from: edit{at: f.Open, text: "("}, edit{at: f.InsertAt, text: ")"}
mutants.to: edit{at: f.Open, text: ""}, edit{at: f.InsertAt, text: ""}
mutants.rule: ergo fix writes the parentheses the clause needs around a lone result of function type.

mutants.name: ex3-takes-no-fix
mutants.rule: A hand-off of a lent parameter carries the takes clause to write, which ergo fix writes (q137).

mutants.name: ex3-takes-rank
mutants.rule: At one offset the clauses go fails, needs, takes: a takes clause is inserted first (grammar.md Declarations 13).

mutants.name: ex3-takes-before-needs
mutants.rule: A new takes clause goes after a written needs clause.

mutants.name: ex3-wire-tparam-uncharged
mutants.from: c.chargeAs(x, &Wired{T: tp, Uses: true}, fmt.Sprintf("the codec of %s, which this %s calls,", tp.Name, what))
mutants.rule: An encode or decode of a type parameter T is charged needs wired[T], so a generic codec writes it (q141).

mutants.name: ex3-instance-wired-kept
mutants.rule: An instance replaces needs wired[T] by its argument's codec needs (q141).

mutants.name: ex3-wired-needs-wire-only
mutants.rule: needs wired[T] is the needs of both directions of each by-name pair T reaches (q141).
